title: From drums and piano to banjo, early bands and brother Manny
summary: He played piano from about 10, drums around 15 or 16, then learned banjo from 1925 to 1934, playing with Sam Morgan, Louis Dumaine and others; his older brother Manny moved from drums to clarinet.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught
